as_told.title: 2005 northern Sweden lake object on military radar and photo

plain: In 2005, in northern Sweden, someone took a phone photo of an unidentified object, and the object is said to have matched a track on military radar. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn, who worked on the case, tells Michels it is known as "the first mobile picture of UFO in Sweden." He places it at a cottage at one point and over a lake at another.
